description: Live OpenRouter provider reliability lookup and routing instructions for tool calling and structured outputs (providers.dottxt.ai). Fetch https://providers.dottxt.ai/m/{openrouter_id}.json or .md directly (or llms.txt), validate status and valid_until expiry, cite as_of, and merge provider.order/ignore while preserving constraints.
rules: Never use cached or indexed provider rankings as current advice. Fetch https://providers.dottxt.ai/m/{openrouter_id}.json (or .md) directly, or check https://providers.dottxt.ai/llms.txt for coverage.
Act on a model's recommendation only when status is 'ok' and the current UTC time is strictly before valid_until; otherwise report status_reason and do not recommend a routing configuration.
Always cite the model JSON's as_of observation date alongside measured error rates, sample sizes, and confidence.

Use top-level invalid_tool_call_rate and recommendation for tool calling; use structured_outputs (structured_output_error_rate and its own status, valid_until, and recommendation) for response_format / structured-output workloads.

When merging OpenRouter provider config, replace order and ignore, drop sort, and preserve existing policy/capability fields (zdr, data_collection, allow_fallbacks, require_parameters, quantizations, max_price, only); flag conflicts.
Scope these instructions to OpenRouter provider selection, routing updates, and OpenRouter tool-call or structured-output failures — not unrelated local JSON parsing or schema bugs.
